purpose: Define least-privilege department managers that report decision-quality summaries upward without receiving full Main Brain authority.
rules: Department managers receive only information necessary for their assigned function.
Department managers do not inherit private Main Brain authority.
Department managers may recommend actions but may not expand their own permissions.
Cross-department access must be explicitly allowlisted by the Main Brain policy layer.
Financial, credential, identity, wallet-secret and private-key material is never included merely because a department requests it.
Owner-facing reports summarize evidence; underlying evidence remains available for review.
A missing or invalid permission fails closed.
